title: Reception One Receptionist-first v6 Paired Development Study

authorized_openings.scope: One credential-free, network-none work cell per turn for the frozen twenty-four-case authored-synthetic paired development cohort.
Gemini 2.5 Flash may act as a medical receptionist and separately complete the exact typed form with a 1024-token thinking budget while thought content remains excluded.
Twenty-four primaries and at most one closed correction per case through the exact Bernie keyless-ADC Sydney Vertex lane, with an absolute forty-eight-call and USD 1 ceiling.

notes: Yuri authorised a receptionist-first prompt, bounded thinking, both the natural response and typed form, a running sanitized notebook and retention of provider-supplied thinking-token counts only.
The API JSON response schema remains the transport-level pre-printed form; it does not redefine the agent as a form-filling clerk.
The broker never parses the natural receptionist response into the typed form, and the deterministic proofreader must admit both channels before releasing only the typed in-memory proposal.
The exact closed v5 twenty-four-case inputs are reused only for paired development comparison and no longer constitute an independent holdout.
Provider, model, project, service account, keyless ADC, Sydney endpoint, authored-synthetic, isolation, no-fallback, no-tool, no-write, call-ceiling and cost-ceiling boundaries remain exact.
The occupied cohort closed all twenty-four cases in twenty-seven calls: nine exact matches, twenty-three releases, one pre-schema no-release and fourteen semantically wrong releases.
All twenty-seven ledgers are consumed; no call followed admission, estimated application cost is USD 0.1017009, and final task-scoped residue is clear.
The v6 capability threshold fails closed. The targeted next candidate is separately versioned development repair, not a reinterpretation of this immutable result.

contract_evidence.note: The inherited typed plan/compiler/proofreader remains authoritative; v6 adds a separately checked natural receptionist channel.
Freshness and supersession remain deterministic typed gates; this study opens no product event, database or write path.

decisions.summary: Evaluate the receptionist-first dual-channel packet on the closed v5 development cases through the exact bounded Sydney Vertex lane after all provider-blocked, isolation, revision, ADC and residue gates pass.

Accept the exact dual-channel schema, receptionist/form agreement checks, twenty-four deterministic typed oracles, one-correction dialogue, count-only thinking usage and zero-call real-isolation result.

Accept the twenty-seven-call cleanup-complete result as fail-closed: nine exact cases, one pre-schema no-release and fourteen self-consistent but semantically wrong releases requiring a separately versioned targeted development repair.

unresolved_gates: A separately versioned repair must teach that binding-table entries are grounded facts and add one-way recognised-intent proofreader assertions before replaying the fifteen misses.
This reused cohort is paired development evidence only; an independent post-teaching evaluation requires a new untouched authored-synthetic cohort.
Real, product-derived, patient, health, clinical, protected or historical data, product/database access, writes, Word, voice, production, deployment and release remain closed.
claim_scope: Twenty-four reused authored-synthetic cases completed through the exact configured Sydney Vertex lane in twenty-seven calls with count-only thinking usage, complete audit chains, consumed ledgers and zero residue.
The dual natural/form channel is operational, but only nine cases match the exact oracle; fourteen wrong typed meanings passed because internal agreement is not independent semantic correctness.
This is a fail-closed paired development result, not holdout generalisation, production fitness, product-data safety, or proof of Australian physical or sovereign processing.
